env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/ro$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/ro$GOEXE
stdout '^ro-ok$'
cd ..

env GOWORK=off
cd w/l
logos eject -o bout
exists bout/p/p.go
exists bout/r/r.go
grep 'Logos_GetNick\(\) string' bout/p/p.go
! grep 'Logos_SetNick' bout/p/p.go
grep 'Logos_GetHP\(\) int' bout/p/p.go
grep 'Logos_SetHP' bout/p/p.go
grep ' Name\(\) string' bout/r/r.go
grep ' Total\(\) int' bout/r/r.go
! grep 'Logos_Set' bout/r/r.go
! grep 'Logos_Get' bout/r/r.go
! grep 'const Name' bout/r/r.go
cd bout
go build ./...
stdout ''
cd ..
cd ../..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/roacc

go 1.27

-- w/l/p/p.lgo --
package p

type Creature interface {
	const Nick string
	HP int
}

type Count struct : Creature {
	Nick string
	HP   int
}

-- w/l/r/r.lgo --
package r

type ReadonlyIface interface {
	const Name() string
	Total() int
}

type Thing struct {
	name string
}

func (Thing) Name() string {
	return "thing"
}

func (t Thing) Total() int {
	return 1
}

var _ ReadonlyIface = Thing{}

func Use(v ReadonlyIface) string {
	return v.Name()
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/roaccg

go 1.27

require example.com/roacc v1.0.0

replace example.com/roacc => ../l

-- w/g/g/g.go --
package g

import "example.com/roacc/p"
import "example.com/roacc/r"

var _ p.Creature = &p.Count{Nick: "c", HP: 3}

func Run() string {
	c := p.Count{Nick: "c", HP: 3}
	if c.Nick != "c" {
		return "bad-name"
	}
	c.HP = 9
	if c.HP != 9 {
		return "bad-total"
	}
	var t r.Thing
	if r.Use(t) != "thing" {
		return "bad-use"
	}
	var ro r.ReadonlyIface = t
	if ro.Name() != "thing" {
		return "bad-ro"
	}
	return "ro-ok"
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/roaccg/g"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(g.Run()) }
